text.aria-label: Subtitle text '6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 forecast runs on Tuesdays, July 2025 to June 2026; mean absolute error of the average of 51 ENS members, 3 seeds. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds. The intervals are wide because every arm's error rises and falls together with the weather; the contrasts in figure 2 pair the arms and are far narrower.'
text.tspan: 6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 forecast runs on Tuesdays, July 2025 to June 2026; mean
absolute error of the average of 51 ENS members, 3 seeds.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds. The intervals are
wide because every arm's error rises and falls together with the weather; the contrasts in
figure 2 pair the arms and are far narrower.
